FAQ — Benefits

Q: When does health insurance coverage start?
A: Coverage begins on the first day of the month following your start date.

Q: Does Alderbrook Systems match 401k contributions?
A: Yes, up to 4% of your salary, matched dollar-for-dollar, vesting immediately.

Q: Are dependents covered?
A: Yes, spouses and children can be added during enrollment or within 30 days of a qualifying
   life event.

Q: Is there a wellness stipend?
A: Yes, $40/month toward gym memberships or wellness apps, submitted via Expensify under
   "Wellness".
